name: Typesense
line: Open-source search engine for text, vector, faceted and geospatial search.

free.text: 720 node-h/10GB out once; 0.5GB RAM/2vCPU; idle billed; terminate deletes data

cells.regions: North and South America, Europe, Africa and Asia-Pacific

sql.math: A vector workload needs a set configuration and region. Exact node rates can only be read with a logged-in billing API key.
Idle clusters still have node-hour charges. Exact configuration and region rates are not public.

files.math: Typesense does not provide general file storage.

jobs.math: Typesense does not provide a job or workflow service.
